pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[ReportingManager\] Execution state for app with id: {GUID} has been updated\. Report delta: \{"{1,2}EnforcementState"{1,2}:\{"{1,2}OldValue"{1,2}:(?:"{1,2}(?<from>\w+)"{1,2}|null),"{1,2}NewValue"{1,2}:"{1,2}(?<to>\w+)"{1,2}(?:\},"{1,2}EnforcementErrorCode"{1,2}:\{"{1,2}OldValue"{1,2}:(?:-?\d+|null),"{1,2}NewValue"{1,2}:(?<errorCode>-?\d+))?
description: Captures enforcement state transitions via ReportingManager. Only triggers error when 'to' value indicates an error state. OldValue may be the unquoted JSON literal null on the first-ever write of a reporting state — transitions straight from the initial state (e.g. first write directly to an error state) would otherwise be invisible (IME 1.97 audit 2026-08-17). Quote-flexible since 2026-08-17: IME 1.104 serializes the report-delta JSON with single quotes ({"Key":...) where older versions logged doubled quotes ({""Key"":...) - every literal quote in the delta is matched as "{1,2} to cover both. The optional errorCode group takes EnforcementErrorCode.NewValue, which IME logs as a signed decimal right after the state object (e.g. -2016345060 = 0x87D1041C: IME's check after the install did not find the app); the code reaches app_install_failed only when this line is the app's first move to Error.
